data.notes: March 2026 in Verbier was driven by après-ski culture, with DJ-led mountain events clustered around Boss des Bosses and the YETI Xtreme Verbier weekend.

events.title: Sculpture Park Beats
events.summary: Music session in the Verbier 3-D Sculpture Park, with DJ NikoBeats performing on the ski slopes near the stork sculpture facing the Corbassière glacier.

events.title: Piano Bar Night
events.venueName: Le Catogne, Route de Verbier Station 29
events.summary: Two-night piano-bar dinner event in Verbier, with the restaurant offering a piano-bar atmosphere from 19:00 on both Friday and Saturday.

events.title: Concert Annuel – Société de Musique l’Avenir de Bagnes
events.summary: Annual concert by the Société de Musique l’Avenir de Bagnes at the Salle Polyvalente de Bruson, focused on brass and percussion under the theme of emotions.

events.title: Boss des Bosses 2026 – Live DJs and Après-Ski
events.summary: The long-running inter-resort mogul competition pairs its on-slope action with live DJs, parties at Bar 1936, and après-ski celebrations at Le Rouge.

events.title: Ush-een Present – Boss des Bosses After-After Party
events.summary: Late-night Boss des Bosses after-after party promoted by Ush-een, listed by Resident Advisor with tech house and electro genres and a TBC lineup.

events.title: SOUTH Restaurant & Club – Jazz & Soul Thursdays and Resident DJ Nights
events.summary: Farinet South’s winter club residency featured Jazz & Soul Thursdays from 21:00, resident DJ Alex Scott, and guest DJs through the season, running into March 2026.

events.title: YETI Xtreme Verbier 2026 – Event Village DJ Program
events.summary: The official FWT Event Village program added three days of music and bar programming, including Red Bull DJ sets, La Nébuleuse DJs, Peak Performance terrace sessions, and SOÂR Xtreme parties.
